input_refs.description: NVDA AI accelerator platform thesis with catalysts and risk factors.
Historical NVDA price-action snapshot through the 2026-04-10 close.
As-of recommendation and decision-quality snapshot without realized outcome fields.

Solver prompts must use only as-of inputs; realized outcome metrics live in outcome_context.

gold_output.simple_thesis: Buy NVDA because it is the dominant full-stack AI accelerator platform, with hyperscaler capex, Blackwell/Rubin visibility, CUDA/software lock-in, and supply commitments supporting earnings power that the market may still underprice.
gold_output.embedded_macro_exposure: Long AI infrastructure capex, hyperscaler data-center spend, semiconductor supply-chain execution, large-cap growth, and continued demand for accelerated computing.

mispricing.consensus_view: The market recognizes NVDA as the AI leader but worries that valuation, customer concentration, export controls, and future AI capex digestion limit forward upside.
mispricing.variant_view: NVDA's full-stack platform, backlog visibility, generation-over-generation cost-per-result advantage, and hyperscaler capex commitments make the earnings runway more durable than a normal semiconductor cycle.
mispricing.pricing_evidence: The thesis cites $215.9B FY26 revenue, $102.7B operating cash flow, a $4.58T market cap, 75.0% Q4 FY26 gross margins, and catalysts including Vera Rubin, May 20 earnings, hyperscaler capex, and Blackwell/Rubin backlog.
mispricing.why_consensus_is_wrong: Consensus may over-anchor on the size of the market cap and underweight how much demand visibility, software lock-in, supply pre-emption, and inference throughput improvements extend the runway.

catalyst_or_reason_now.event_or_condition: Technical confirmation at initiation, further research confirmation, and the May 20, 2026 earnings catalyst.
catalyst_or_reason_now.expected_timeframe: Initiation on 2026-04-10 with earnings validation on 2026-05-20.
catalyst_or_reason_now.why_now: The position was initiated after NVDA closed above all selected moving averages with positive 1m/3m/12m ROC and S&P 500 relative outperformance, while further investigation supported the thesis and earnings were approaching.

invalidation.observable: NVDA fails the remaining price or earnings validation, or core AI demand/margin assumptions deteriorate.
invalidation.metric_or_event: Close above $198 bear-case validation level, May 20, 2026 earnings/guidance, hyperscaler capex commentary, gross margin trajectory, export-control impact, and post-earnings price response.
invalidation.threshold: Force review if NVDA cannot close above $198 after initiation, May 20 earnings/guidance fail to confirm AI accelerator demand and margin durability, hyperscaler capex commitments weaken, or the stock breaks back below the 100D/150D/200D/40W moving-average cluster on thesis-relevant news.
invalidation.timeframe: Price validation and earnings validation through the May 20, 2026 catalyst and the following 1-2 trading weeks.
invalidation.implication: The market may already price the AI platform thesis, or the next leg of earnings power may be less certain than the thesis requires.

evidence_for.claim: NVDA had dominant AI platform economics.
evidence_for.support: The thesis cites full-stack moat from CUDA, NVLink, Mellanox networking, DPUs, and generation-level cost-per-result advantages.

evidence_against.claim: The $198 bear-case validation level had not yet been cleared at initiation.
evidence_against.support: The April 10 close was $188.63, below the user-defined $198 bear-case validation level.

price_action_read.observed_behavior: NVDA closed at $188.63 on 2026-04-10, above the provided moving averages with positive ROC and relative outperformance versus the S&P 500, but below the $198 bear-case validation level.
price_action_read.interpretation: Price action supported initiation but not full validation: trend and relative strength were positive, while the $198 level and May 20 earnings remained confirmation gates.

actionability.reason: The setup had a clear quality-compounder thesis, technical confirmation, relative outperformance, further research confirmation, and a near-term earnings catalyst, with remaining validation gates clearly defined.

expression.follow_on: Add or maintain conviction after a close above $198 and strong May 20, 2026 earnings.

conviction.upgrade_condition: Further validation from a close above $198 and strong May 20, 2026 earnings could justify maintaining or increasing conviction toward 5.

gold_output.confidence_reason: Moderately high because thesis quality, technical confirmation, relative strength, and further investigation aligned; capped because the $198 validation level and May 20 earnings confirmation were still pending.

sizing_context.starting_size: Conviction 4 at initiation maps to a 16% raw target weight under portfolio_sizer.py.
sizing_context.add_conditions: Add or maintain higher conviction only if NVDA closes above $198 and May 20 earnings/guidance confirm demand, margins, and backlog strength.
sizing_context.liquidity_constraints: No ADV or exit-cost input selected.
sizing_context.portfolio_constraints: Final size should account for existing semiconductor, AI infrastructure, and large-cap growth exposure.

sizing_delta.condition: Initial conviction 4 buy; add only after $198 and earnings validation.

trade_after_trade.if_right: If $198 is cleared and earnings are strong, keep pressing the AI infrastructure leader or add toward higher conviction.
trade_after_trade.if_wrong: If NVDA fails $198, disappoints on earnings/guidance, or rejects good news, reduce confidence and avoid adding.

human_notes: Reviewed post-mortem fixture: process was sound but the one-month outcome underperformed SPY after initiation.

outcome_context.final_postmortem: The thesis and actionability gate were reasonable at initiation, but the one-month outcome underperformed SPY because the $198 validation and May earnings catalyst did not confirm quickly enough.
outcome_context.lessons_learned: Do not treat partial technical confirmation as sufficient when a explicit price-validation gate and near-term catalyst are still unresolved; catalyst failed before the review horizon ended.
outcome_context.notes: Realized outcome metrics and post-mortem text are for grading and calibration only. They must not be treated as known at the decision date.
